name: FLORAL: The Blooming Cycle
source:
You've moved in to your new home in Bloomington - reunited with your bestie, Bailey - just in time for the event of the season: the Bloomington spring festival. According to Bailey, it's more fun to go with a date, but Bailey's dating game is... practically nonexistent. That's okay, though, because now you're on the case! You want to meet their friends anyway... it's a perfect opportunity to slip in a little romance on the side.

As Macy, you have seven days to get used to the town and find Bailey a date. People keep gifting you plants, there are cats in your backyard, and what is UP with that new donut shop?

[from [url=https://bee7worms.itch.io/floral-the-blooming-cycle]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你搬进了Bloomington的新家，与挚友Bailey重聚，还正好赶上本季盛事：Bloomington春日祭。按Bailey的说法，带个约会对象去会更有趣，可Bailey在恋爱方面的本事……几乎为零。不过没关系，你已经接下这个任务了！反正你本来就想认识那些朋友……这可是顺手撮合一段恋情的绝佳机会。

你将扮演Macy，在七天内熟悉小镇，并为Bailey找到约会对象。人们不停送你植物，后院里来了些猫，还有那家新开的甜甜圈店，到底是怎么回事？

[摘自[url=https://bee7worms.itch.io/floral-the-blooming-cycle]itch.io[/url]]
